title: Groove Mosaic
description:
Groove Mosaic is a jazz ensemble formed by Paolo Dumancas, a former coworker who now runs a nonprofit that gives underprivileged and underrepresented musicians opportunities and support. The group has a rotating cast of local musicians who want to make an impact, and the nonprofit aims to give back to the community through that music.

I recorded these two tracks with local jazz musicians over an 8 hour session. I did the tracking, mixing, and mastering, working one-on-one for a semester under my professor Nick Landis, who guided me on these tracks and other skills.
